definitions.explanation: Someone who has achieved mastery in a particular skill or art.

definitions.gloss: title holder (in games like shogi or go)
definitions.explanation: The holder of the highest title in traditional Japanese board games.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{料理|りょうり}の{名人|めいじん}だ。
{将棋|しょうぎ}の{名人|めいじん}{戦|せん}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The shogi Meijin championship has begun.

examples.japanese: {節約|せつやく}{名人|めいじん}と{呼|よ}ばれている。
examples.english: I'm called a master of saving money.

notes:
Can refer to serious expertise or be used somewhat humorously for everyday skills.

TYPES OF {名人|めいじん}:
・{将棋|しょうぎ}{名人|めいじん} (shogi master/title holder)
・{囲碁|いご}{名人|めいじん} (go master/title holder)
・{料理|りょうり}{名人|めいじん} (master chef)
・{節約|せつやく}{名人|めいじん} (expert at saving money)
・{言|い}い{訳|わけ}{名人|めいじん} (expert at making excuses)

TITLE USAGE:
In {将棋|しょうぎ} and {囲碁|いご}, {名人|めいじん} is one of the highest titles, earned through championship tournaments.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{達人|たつじん} (master, expert)
・{専門家|せんもんか} (specialist)
